comments.body: there r two different notions: u must have 10 reco 12 unlock in order to pull it, but then u only need r1 to complete it. it's the only explanation I can offer to this incongruous piece of info.

comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
It'd actually make sense, if I didn't get prof for both recog and unlock, while using the map. It also wasn't some minor prof, which I'd be getting for r1.
My guess is an error in description (during localization process maybe).

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Definitely an error in the description's localization; I gave the map to a friend with r7 unlock, and they got the message 'Nothing discovered'. Meaning they didn't have enough unlock to open the map. I got the map back, and on my first recognition use, got the message 'Looks like there's something around here'. Several more tries, and boom, treasure. Without both r10-12 Recognition and Unlock, this map cannot be opened (and can't be obtained from the Archives, either).

Located at: 897,1874 (northern tip of that small island north-east of Stockholm)

Rewards: 148,320 ducats, plus the black Broad Felt Hat.
